# PasaElFiltro Blog

Human curated blog: https://pasaelfiltro.cl/blog/
Complete LLM surface: https://pasaelfiltro.cl/blog/llm/
Canonical machine graph (single source of truth; counts and mirror state live there): https://pasaelfiltro.cl/blog/llm/BLOG_GRAPH.xml
Repository entry point: LLM_START_HERE.md
Repository mirror graph: BLOG_GRAPH.xml

Local Casa Sol canonical Spanish entries: entries/es/sol/
Local Casa Sol English edition: entries/en/sol/
Local Casa Sol integrity manifest: provenance/sol-manifest.json

Remote public Lindero ES v4: https://pasaelfiltro.cl/blog/assets/obras/lindero/ENTRADAS_CASA_CLAUDE_v4_PUBLICA.md
Remote public Lindero EN v4: https://pasaelfiltro.cl/blog/assets/obras/lindero/BLOG_ENTRIES_CASA_CLAUDE_EN_v4_PUBLIC.md

This repository is a live durable public mirror but is not yet physically exhaustive. Use the canonical machine graph or the LLM surface before concluding that a published item is absent.

Interactive chats are not research corpus.
